candidates.source_name: CBCG — Statistički podaci (Statistical Data portal)
candidates.why_relevant: Master index of all CBCG official statistics domains (monetary/financial, financial soundness indicators, interest rates, T-bills, capital market, external sector, payment system, real and fiscal sector). Single hub from which every ME banking statistics series is reachable; anchor node for A4.
candidates.legal_status: public official statistics, reuse normally allowed with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly HTML crawl of the hub + child pages; extract file links (zip/xls/pdf) and 'last updated' dates for change detection
queries_used: Centralna banka Crne Gore statistika bankarskog sistema mjesečni bilten
Central Bank of Montenegro statistics banking sector time series xls

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Statistics (English mirror of statistical data portal)
candidates.why_relevant: English-language mirror of the same statistics tree (Monetary and Financial Statistics, Financial Soundness Indicators, Interest Rates, Payment System, etc.). Useful for stable English labels/mapping of Montenegrin table names; underlying data files are typically bilingual.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl in parallel with /me tree; use as bilingual label dictionary
candidates.discovered_via_method: fetched EN counterpart of the ME statistics hub
queries_used: Central Bank of Montenegro statistics banking sector time series xls

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Monetarna i finansijska statistika (Monetary and Financial Statistics)
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated compilation of monetary statistics under the Law on Official Statistics, using ECB and IMF methodology. Parent of the MFI and other-financial-institution datasets that carry aggregate bank balance sheet, deposits and loans series — the core banking market statistics for a euroised economy.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scheduled fetch keyed to the CBCG statistics release calendar; download and unzip the dataset archives
queries_used: Centralna banka Crne Gore statistika bankarskog sistema mjesečni bilten

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Statistika monetarnih finansijskih institucija (MFI statistics, monthly ZIP)
candidates.why_relevant: The single most important machine-readable release for A4: a monthly ZIP of MFI (bank) statistics — aggregate balance sheet, deposits and loans by sector/maturity, reported in euro. Highest-resolution primary banking market data for Montenegro.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly file harvest; filename pattern statistika_monetarnih_finansijskih_institucija_<mjesec>_<god>.zip — parse the page for the current link rather than guessing filenames
queries_used: CBCG makroekonomski izvještaj agregatni bilans banaka xls

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Indikatori finansijske stabilnosti (Financial Soundness Indicators)
candidates.why_relevant: Quarterly IMF-methodology FSIs for the banking sector: capital adequacy, liquidity, profitability, asset quality/NPLs, sectoral and geographic credit distribution, FX exposure, real-estate segments. Built from supervisory returns, so it is a creation-point series unavailable elsewhere.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly fetch; watch for methodology/reporting-form breaks (page carried a notice that Q1 2026 publication was postponed pending new reporting forms)
queries_used: CBCG financial stability report banking indicators download

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Kamatne stope (Bank and MFI interest rate statistics)
candidates.why_relevant: Weighted average nominal and effective active/passive interest rates of banks by sector, purpose and maturity, for stock and new business, plus a separate microcredit-institution series. Core pricing dimension of the banking market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly file harvest of the linked zip archives
queries_used: Centralna banka Crne Gore statistika bankarskog sistema mjesečni bilten
local_language_terms_used: ponderisane aktivne i pasivne kamatne stope

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Platni promet (Payment system statistics section)
candidates.why_relevant: Statistics-section home for realised payment traffic in the CBCG RTGS and DNS systems, updated monthly as ZIP archives, plus a historical archive of national payment traffic indicators up to 31.12.2017 (pre-methodology-break series). Directly relevant to payment statistics.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly harvest of the RTGS/DNS zip; separately archive the pre-2018 legacy zip once and record the 2017/2018 methodology break
queries_used: CBCG statistika platnog prometa statistika platnih usluga kartice bankomati POS

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu (quarterly payment services & e-money data)
candidates.why_relevant: Highest-value source in the whole cell for card/ATM/POS intelligence: quarterly ZIP datasets on number of users by payment service type, number of payment cards issued in Montenegro, number of card-acceptance devices (ATM/POS/other), payment transactions by service type, card and e-money transactions domestic and abroad, and cash deposit/withdrawal transactions.
candidates.legal_status: official statistics collected under the Decision on reports submitted to CBCG on payment transactions; public
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly harvest; observed filename patterns broj_koris_vrste_platnih_usluga_qN-YYYY.zip, broj_izdatih_platnih_kartica_cg_qN-YYYY.zip, broj_uredjaja_prihvatanje_platnih_kartica_qN-YYYY.zip — parse the page for live links
queries_used: CBCG statistika platnog prometa statistika platnih usluga kartice bankomati POS

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Statistika platnog sistema Centralne banke Crne Gore (RTGS/DNS monthly reports)
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly narrative + PDF reporting on volume and value of orders in the CBCG RTGS and DNS systems, RTGS/DNS split, daily averages and system availability. Complements the statistics-section ZIPs with operational commentary and a longer archive.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly page scrape + PDF download and table extraction
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from payment statistics search results
queries_used: CBCG gotovina novčanice i kovanice statistika gotovinski promet izvještaj

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Bilten CBCG (monthly statistical bulletin)
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly bilingual (sr/en) bulletin with a statistical annex covering monetary developments, the banking system, balance of payments and payment transactions. Convenient single-document time series and the fastest way to detect definition changes. Note a 2025 break: from mid-2025 the bulletin is numbered rather than month-named and dropped real-sector tables.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly PDF download from the archive listing; table extraction from the statistical annex; keep pre- and post-2025 schema mappings
queries_used: Centralna banka Crne Gore statistika bankarskog sistema mjesečni bilten

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Makroekonomski izvještaj CBCG (Macroeconomic Report)
candidates.why_relevant: Periodic macro report that contextualises banking-sector aggregates (credit growth, deposits, NPLs, interest rates) and often carries derived tables and charts not present in the raw statistical releases.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly page scrape + PDF archive download
queries_used: CBCG makroekonomski izvještaj agregatni bilans banaka xls

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Izvještaj o stabilnosti finansijskog sistema (Financial System Stability Report)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual/periodic financial stability report — banking sector structure, concentration, asset quality, stress tests, and often payment-system oversight sections. Key narrative and derived-indicator source for market structure.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual archive crawl + PDF text/table extraction
queries_used: CBCG financial stability report banking indicators download

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Makroprudencijalna analiza i politika (Macroprudential Analysis and Policy)
candidates.why_relevant: Macroprudential analysis series carrying credit-cycle, household/corporate indebtedness and bank-sector vulnerability indicators; complements FSIs with policy-relevant derived metrics.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic archive crawl
queries_used: CBCG financial stability report banking indicators download

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Izvještaj o rezultatima ankete o kreditnoj aktivnosti banaka (Bank Lending Survey)
candidates.why_relevant: ECB-style bank lending survey for Montenegro — credit standards, demand, and terms by segment. Forward-looking soft data on the banking market that no aggregator republishes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly archive crawl
queries_used: CBCG makroekonomski izvještaj agregatni bilans banaka xls

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Kalendar objavljivanja statistike (Statistics Release Calendar)
candidates.why_relevant: Advance release calendar for every statistic CBCG is the official producer of. Lets a collector schedule fetches precisely instead of polling, and detect missed or postponed releases (a real risk here — FSI Q1 2026 was postponed).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download (pattern /uploads/kalendar_objavljivanja_<year>.pdf) and parse into a scheduling table
queries_used: cbcg.me kalendar objavljivanja statističkih podataka izvještaj o finansijskoj stabilnosti makroekonomski izvještaj

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Nadležnost Centralne banke za statistiku (statistical mandate & methodology)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines which statistics CBCG is legally the official producer of under the Law on Official Statistics and which methodologies (ECB/IMF) apply. Essential for boundary-setting between CBCG and MONSTAT series and for interpreting definition changes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch plus annual re-check for mandate changes
queries_used: cbcg.me kalendar objavljivanja statističkih podataka izvještaj o finansijskoj stabilnosti makroekonomski izvještaj

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Podzakonski akti: Statistika (reporting decisions and report templates)
candidates.why_relevant: The decisions and annexed reporting forms that credit institutions must submit (statistical data, payment traffic reports incl. acceptance-device and card forms, banknote/coin denomination forms). Reading the forms reveals the exact fields CBCG holds — including granular ATM/POS and cash variables that may not all be published — and warns of schema changes before they hit the published series.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the regulation listing; download decision PDFs and their annexes; diff annex field lists across versions to detect schema breaks
queries_used: CBCG gotovina novčanice i kovanice statistika gotovinski promet izvještaj
CBCG statistika platnog prometa statistika platnih usluga kartice bankomati POS
local_language_terms_used: odluka o izvještajima koji se dostavljaju CBCG

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Finansijski izvještaji banaka (bank-level financial statements)
candidates.why_relevant: Quarterly and audited annual financial statements per individual bank, archived back to roughly 2011. Enables bank-level market-share, concentration and profitability analysis that aggregate statistics cannot support — the disaggregation layer under the CBCG statistics.
candidates.source_subtype: supervisory disclosure portal (PDF/ZIP per bank per quarter)
candidates.legal_status: public disclosure; CBCG explicitly disclaims responsibility for accuracy of bank-submitted figures
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly structured crawl by bank x period; store PDFs and extract balance sheet / income statement tables
queries_used: CBCG statistika platnog prometa statistika platnih usluga kartice bankomati POS

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Tarife banaka / pregledi tarifa pružalaca platnih usluga
candidates.why_relevant: CBCG-maintained comparative overview of bank payment-service tariffs (account, card, ATM withdrawal, transfer fees). Pricing intelligence for the card/ATM/POS layer, sourced from the regulator rather than from each bank's own site.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic (quarterly) scrape/snapshot of tariff tables and linked bank tariff documents
queries_used: CBCG statistika platnog prometa statistika platnih usluga kartice bankomati POS

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Registri: platni sistemi, platne institucije i agenti, institucije elektronskog novca
candidates.why_relevant: Official registers of licensed payment systems, payment institutions and their agents. These enumerate the actor universe (who must report the payment/card statistics) and are the canonical snowball list for A4 actor mapping in Montenegro.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape with diffing to detect new/removed licensed entities
queries_used: CBCG statistika platnog prometa statistika platnih usluga kartice bankomati POS

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Godišnji finansijski iskazi Centralne banke Crne Gore
candidates.why_relevant: Audited annual financial statements of the central bank itself. Secondary for market statistics but the authoritative record of CBCG's own balance sheet, currency-in-circulation-related items and payment-system revenue, useful as a cross-check on cash-usage and payment-system throughput narratives.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download (pattern fs_cbcg_<year>.pdf)
queries_used: CBCG gotovina novčanice i kovanice statistika gotovinski promet izvještaj

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Mapa sajta (site map)
candidates.why_relevant: Full enumeration of the CBCG site tree. The site uses multiple interchangeable path prefixes (/me/, /r/, /c/, /public/, and odd legacy prefixes), so the sitemap is the safest way to enumerate canonical statistics URLs and detect page moves rather than treating a 404 as a dead source.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as crawl seed; re-fetch monthly to detect URL structure changes
queries_used: cbcg.me kalendar objavljivanja statističkih podataka izvještaj o finansijskoj stabilnosti makroekonomski izvještaj

negative_findings.description: No evidence was found of a CBCG statistical database, SDMX endpoint, open-data API or per-series query interface. All statistical releases observed are distributed as ZIP archives of spreadsheets or as PDFs, published section by section.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched the statistics portal (sr and en) and all its subsections; every dataset link encountered was a .zip or .pdf. No 'baza podataka' / 'data browser' / API affordance surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be file-harvest plus spreadsheet parsing, not API polling. Series identity has to be reconstructed from sheet/column labels, which makes methodology-break detection a manual concern.

negative_findings.description: No standalone CBCG statistical release dedicated to cash usage / currency in circulation / banknote-and-coin turnover was located. Montenegro is unilaterally euroised and does not issue its own currency, so no issuance statistics exist.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'gotovina', 'novčanice i kovanice', 'gotovinski promet' returned reporting-form annexes (denomination templates), the CBCG's own audited financial statements, and payment statistics pages — but no published cash-usage time series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cash-usage intelligence for ME must be inferred indirectly, chiefly from the quarterly cash deposit/withdrawal transaction tables inside the payment services dataset and from ATM withdrawal counts, not from a dedicated series.

negative_findings.description: Two observed discontinuities plus one active delay: national payment traffic indicators were collected on a different basis up to 31.12.2017 (separate legacy archive); the Bilten changed naming and dropped real-sector tables from mid-2025; and the Financial Soundness Indicators page carried a notice that Q1 2026 publication was postponed pending new reporting forms.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded from the payment-statistics, Bilten and FSI pages directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive time-series join across these boundaries would produce false trend conclusions, and an FSI collector must tolerate a missing quarter without treating the source as dead.

negative_findings.description: The cbcg.me site serves the same content under many interchangeable path prefixes (/me/, /en/, /r/, /c/, /public/, and legacy prefixes such as /kursna_lista_arhiva.php/... and /orhanpamuk/...). Search engines surface these variants inconsistently.
negative_findings.result_summary: Observed across multiple search result sets returning the same page under different prefixes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: URL-based deduplication and liveness checks will misfire; a 404 on one prefix is not evidence the source is gone. Canonicalise to the /me/ and /en/ prefixes and re-seed from the sitemap.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice is claimed as verified-live. Several were reached only through search-result metadata or a single successful fetch; deep file links (dated ZIPs) will rotate with each release.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dated file URLs such as the July 2026 MFI ZIP and the quarterly payment ZIP filename patterns were read off pages and should be re-resolved by parsing the parent page at collection time rather than by constructing filenames.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hard-coding dated filenames will silently break the collector each period.

coverage_gaps.description: Published card/ATM/POS data appears to be quarterly aggregates (counts of cards, acceptance devices, transactions). No public breakdown by scheme (Visa/Mastercard/Dina), by issuer bank, by contactless vs contact, or by merchant category was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-reference the reporting-form annexes to establish what CBCG actually collects, then seek scheme-level and issuer-level detail from other cells (scheme reports, acquirer/processor disclosures, bank annual reports) rather than expecting CBCG to publish it.

coverage_gaps.description: The contents of the ZIP archives (sheet names, table inventory, series start dates, whether English column labels are present) were not inspected in this pass — only the parent pages were read.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Download one archive per dataset family (MFI, FSI, interest rates, payment traffic, payment services) and build a table inventory with series coverage dates before designing the parser.

coverage_gaps.description: The boundary between CBCG series and MONSTAT (Uprava za statistiku Crne Gore) series was not mapped, although the release calendar is jointly published and MONSTAT hosts the consolidated national calendar.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign or extend a cell to MONSTAT and reconcile the official-producer split via the CBCG 'Nadležnost za statistiku' page and the MONSTAT calendar at monstat.org.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage was conducted in Montenegrin/Serbian (ijekavian, Latin script) and English. Cyrillic-script variants of the key terms (Централна банка Црне Горе, статистика, платни промет) were not separately tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a Cyrillic-transliteration query pass to confirm no additional CBCG or mirror content is indexed only under Cyrillic forms.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unclear how deep the CBCG online archives go for each dataset family and whether superseded vintages are retained after revision (the file links observed are current-period only for MFI and interest rates).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the per-section archive listings and, where vintages are overwritten, snapshot each release on publication and consider Wayback Machine backfill for historical vintages.

brief: CBCG is unambiguously the creation point for Montenegrin banking and payment statistics: as designated official producer under the Law on Official Statistics it compiles monetary statistics to ECB/IMF methodology and publishes on an advance release calendar. The landscape splits into four layers — machine-readable statistical releases (monthly MFI ZIP, monthly interest rates, monthly RTGS/DNS payment traffic, quarterly financial soundness indicators, and the quarterly payment services and e-money datasets that carry cards, ATM/POS acceptance devices and cash deposit/withdrawal transactions), narrative publications (Bilten, macroeconomic report, financial stability report, bank lending survey), supervisory disclosure (per-bank quarterly and audited financial statements, tariff comparisons), and pointer infrastructure (release calendar, registers, reporting-form annexes, sitemap). Everything is open-access, free and in ZIP or PDF form — there is no API, no SDMX endpoint and no series-level query interface, so collection must be scheduled file harvesting driven by the release calendar with parsers over spreadsheets and PDFs. The main risks are dated filenames that rotate each period, interchangeable URL prefixes that make single-fetch liveness verdicts unreliable, and three known discontinuities (the 2017/2018 payment-traffic methodology break, the mid-2025 Bilten restructuring, and the postponed Q1 2026 FSI release).
